notes: The local stdio server requires no API key or hosted account.
Metadata follows Selvedge v0.3.16 server.json, pyproject.toml, and selvedge/server.py.
Requires uv. Use a supported Python release (3.11–3.14); the package also accepts Python 3.10 for compatibility.
SELVEDGE_DB is optional. Set it to the absolute path of the project's .selvedge/selvedge.db when the client starts outside the project. See the quickstart for initialization and agent instructions.
